description: This file implements the DnsOverHttpsConfig class and related functions for parsing, serializing, and managing DNS over HTTPS server configurations within the Chromium project.

classes.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration for DNS over HTTPS, including server list and serialization/deserialization methods.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig::FromString
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or template list into a DnsOverHttpsConfig object.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig::FromTemplates
methods.description: Creates a configuration from a list of server templates.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig::FromStringLax
methods.description: Lax parsing of configuration, allowing fallback to templates.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig::ToString
methods.description: Serializes the configuration to a JSON string or templates.

methods.name: DnsOverHttpsConfig::ToValue
methods.description: Converts the configuration to a base::Value dictionary.
